task_description: Elementwise y = x*scale + bias over a (512, 128) bf16 array in 4 row-blocks via pltpu.emit_pipeline: no_pipelining=True versus the default no_pipelining=False.

metrics.name: dma_wait_fraction
metrics.description: Fraction of kernel time spent waiting on HBM<->VMEM DMA rather than computing. Requires a profiler trace; median kernel time for a fixed data volume is a coarser proxy.

notes: emit_pipeline queries TPU device information even under interpret=True; on a host without a TPU, wrap the pallas_call in jax.sharding.use_abstract_mesh with an AbstractDevice naming the TPU generation (see guide.md).
